question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 3 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ above. Which of the following represents the corresponding quadratic form ${x}^{T}\,Ax$ in terms of the components of $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]?$
question.worked_solution:
**Method 1**

Each entry ${a}_{ij}$ of $A$ corresponds to the term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{x}_{j}$ in the expression of the quadratic form:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ax & =2{x}_{1}{x}_{1}+(3){x}_{1}{x}_{2}+(3){x}_{2}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}{x}_{2} \\  & =2{x}_{1}^{2}+3{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}^{2} \\  & =2{x}_{1}^{2}+6{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

**Method 2**

To write down a quadratic form in terms of vector components, we compute the following expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ax & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 3 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={x}_{1}(2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2})+{x}_{2}(3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}) \\  & =2{x}_{1}^{2}+3{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}^{2} \\  & =2{x}_{1}^{2}+6{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
